title: Recovery
levelTitle: Level 28 - Cisco IOS and IOS XE

cards.q: What does recovery cover on IOS and IOS XE?
cards.a: Regaining access after lost passwords, corrupt images, or failed boots. Methods include password recovery using the config-register trick, ROMMON for image recovery, and emergency access on modern IOS XE.

cards.q: What do the config-register values 0x2102, 0x2142, and 0x2100 mean?
cards.a: 0x2102 is normal boot (with ROM monitor available), 0x2142 ignores the startup-config and is used for recovery, and 0x2100 boots directly to ROMMON.

cards.q: What are the steps for IOS password recovery?
cards.a: Power cycle or send the break sequence, set the register to 0x2142, boot, copy startup-config running-config to restore the config, change the password, reset config-register 0x2102, save, and reload.

cards.q: What is ROMMON and when do you use it?
cards.a: ROMMON (ROM monitor) is a minimal bootloader environment reached by the break sequence or config-register 0x2100. It allows booting without an image using commands such as boot, dir, and set, for example boot flash:... .

cards.q: How can you recover a corrupt or missing IOS image?
cards.a: From ROMMON, boot a flash image, use a USB device image, load slowly via Xmodem over the console, or copy from TFTP in ROMMON; on IOS XE use rommon with xmodem or USB.

cards.q: What is emergency access on IOS XE and which command enables it?
cards.a: Emergency access is the modern IOS XE way to regain access when locked out. platform console virtual enables the virtual console so you can set a security password and exit back to normal operation.

cards.q: After password recovery, why must you reset the config-register to 0x2102 before reloading?
cards.a: Because 0x2142 ignores the startup-config; leaving it set means the device will keep skipping the saved config on every future boot instead of loading it normally.

cards.q: You cannot reach ROMMON with the break sequence. What is the likely cause?
cards.a: The break signal was missed due to timing. Send the break sequence during the boot window, or verify console connection and timing; ROMMON access also comes from config-register 0x2100.
